messages.author: 64dd3e60f9213f7d
messages.subject: Subsetting word strings
parts:
Hi all,

I'd be grateful for help with the following question related to subsetting strings of words:

Say, I have a column with short backchannel responses (oh, yeah, mm right, oh yes that's right mm, etc.) and I want to single out all responses consisting of / starting with "oh" and suppose there are too many variants to enumerate them all in a query like

oh_all<-subset(x, x[,1]=="oh" | x[,1]=="oh yes" | x,1]=="oh god dear")

is there a possiblity to work with something like wildcards (*) or any other means to define that subset with all its variants more economically?

Best
Chris

messages.author: 3edc58ee737edd94
messages.subject: Re: [CorpLing with R] Subsetting word strings
parts:
oh_all<-subset(x, grepl("^oh ", x,1], perl=TRUE)) # or something like that?

STG
